const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),crypto=require('crypto');const servedSourceSha256={};const{chromium}=require('playwright');const chrome=require('./browser-runtime/node_modules/@sparticuz/chromium');
(async()=>{const root=path.resolve('repo');const server=require('http').createServer((req,res)=>{let f=path.join(root,decodeURIComponent(req.url.split('?')[0]));try{if(fs.statSync(f).isDirectory())f=path.join(f,'index.html');res.setHeader('Content-Type',f.endsWith('.js')||f.endsWith('.mjs')?'text/javascript':f.endsWith('.html')?'text/html':f.endsWith('.css')?'text/css':f.endsWith('.json')?'application/json':'application/octet-stream');const bytes=fs.readFileSync(f);if(f.endsWith('.js'))servedSourceSha256[path.relative(root,f)]=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');res.end(bytes);}catch(e){res.statusCode=404;res.end('missing')}});await new Promise(r=>server.listen(8767,'127.0.0.1',r));const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true,executablePath:path.resolve('chromium-bin/chromium'),args:[...chrome.args,'--enable-unsafe-swiftshader']});const page=await browser.newPage({viewport:{width:800,height:600},isMobile:true,hasTouch:true,deviceScaleFactor:1});const errors=[],bad=[];page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));page.on('response',r=>{if(r.status()>=400)bad.push({url:r.url(),status:r.status()})});let start=Date.now();await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8767/showroom/globe/h-earth/?visual=terrain-relief-v2&performance=1');let ready=false;try{await page.waitForSelector('#h-earth-functional-landscape-route[data-run8e-ready="true"]',{timeout:180000});ready=true;}catch(e){errors.push(e.message)}const readyMs=Date.now()-start;await page.waitForTimeout(2500);const before=await page.evaluate(()=>window.H_EARTH_RUN8E_PUBLIC_ROUTE?.getIntakeReceipt());const canvas=page.locator('canvas').first();await canvas.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();const box=await canvas.boundingBox();const client=await page.context().newCDPSession(page);const x=box.x+box.width*.4,y=box.y+box.height*.5;await client.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent',{type:'touchStart',touchPoints:[{x,y,id:1},{x:x+70,y,id:2}]});await client.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent',{type:'touchMove',touchPoints:[{x,y:y-65,id:1},{x:x+70,y:y-65,id:2}]});await page.waitForTimeout(700);await client.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent',{type:'touchEnd',touchPoints:[]});const after=await page.evaluate(()=>window.H_EARTH_RUN8E_PUBLIC_ROUTE?.getIntakeReceipt());let vegetation=false;try{await page.waitForSelector('#h-earth-functional-landscape-route[data-vegetation-residency="complete"]',{timeout:180000});vegetation=true;}catch(e){errors.push('VEGETATION:'+e.message)}const resources=await page.evaluate(()=>window.H_EARTH_RUN8E_PUBLIC_ROUTE?.getLiveGpuReceipt());fs.writeFileSync('woodland-public-route-input.json',JSON.stringify({readyMs,before,after,vegetation,resources,servedSourceSha256,errors,bad},null,2));const state=await page.evaluate(()=>({attrs:[...document.querySelector('#h-earth-functional-landscape-route')?.attributes??[]].map(a=>[a.name,a.value]),globals:Object.keys(window).filter(k=>/H_EARTH|RUN8E/.test(k)),text:document.body.innerText.slice(-1500)}));await page.screenshot({path:'woodland-public-route-tablet.png'});fs.writeFileSync('woodland-public-route-result.json',JSON.stringify({ready,elapsedMs:Date.now()-start,errors,bad,state},null,2));console.log(JSON.stringify({ready,elapsedMs:Date.now()-start,errors,bad,state}));await browser.close();server.close()})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)});
